name: Namaste Wolverhampton
headline: Authentic Nepalese & Indian food in Wolverhampton
intro: The first Nepalese & Indian fusion restaurant in Wolverhampton. Momo, curries, biryani and a stunning cocktail bar, cooked with love by chefs with over 20 years' experience.
about: At Namaste we bring the flavours of Nepal and India together. Every dish is crafted with care, from steaming momo to rich curries and fragrant biryanis. Join us for a quiet dinner, a family celebration or cocktails at the bar.
hours_note: Christmas Day: 3pm - 10pm with festive set menus.

chat.greeting: Namaste! 🙏 I can book you a table, or answer questions about our menu, offers and opening times.
chat.extra_info:
Free on-site parking, wheelchair accessible, private entrance for events.
Head chef: Krishana Prasad Sapkota. General manager: Bishnu Lamichhane.
Momo come in Chicken, Veg or Paneer; styles Steamed, Fried, Chilli, Kothey or Jhol.
Christmas Day set menus per person (3pm-10pm): Veg £30, Vegan £35, Non veg £45, Sea food £55. Each includes welcome drink, appetizer, starter platter, main, two sides and dessert.

faq.a: All our food is cooked medium spicy. Let us know if you would like it mild or extra spicy.

faq.q: Do you have a vegan menu?
faq.a: Yes, a separate vegan menu with starters, mains, sides and dessert.
Spend over £20 on a collection order, by phone or online.

faq.q: Can I hire a private space?
faq.a: Yes. Private dining for up to 35 guests and a party hall for 40-45. Call 01902 939380.

seo.description: Namaste Wolverhampton - Nepalese & Indian restaurant on Dudley Road. Momo, curries, biryani, vegan menu, cocktail bar and free party hall. Book a table or order online.
